summary.text: La Keisha Jackson is a Democrat who was elected to the Indiana Senate in 2024 and represents District 34, which includes the east side of Indianapolis and portions of Lawrence.
She is chief executive officer of the Pathway Resource Center and serves as treasurer of the Indiana Black Legislative Caucus.

paragraphs.text: According to her Indiana Senate Democrats biography, Jackson holds a Master of Business Administration from Indiana Wesleyan University and an honorary doctorate in philosophy in business administration from Trinity International University.
She received the Mayor's Achievement Award in 2008 and 2012 and a 2024 Lifetime Achievement Award presented by President Joe Biden, and the page says she lives in Indianapolis.
